# The "test" passes while sum.txt holds the right values; mutations change it.
[!exec:sh] skip
chmod 0755 check.sh slow.sh

! exec mutate muts.json -- sh check.sh
stdout '^\(baseline\) +ok +0 '
stdout '^add_wrong +caught +1 '
stdout '^comment +survived +0 '
stdout '^two_files +caught +1 '
stdout '^wrong_reason +unmatched +1 '
stdout '^2 caught, 1 survived, 1 unmatched of 4$'
stdout '--- comment survived'
! stdout '--- add_wrong'
cmp sum.txt sum.orig
cmp other.txt other.orig

# With every mutation caught the exit status is 0; JSON carries the statuses.
exec mutate -json caught.json -- sh check.sh
stdout '"status": "caught"'
stdout '"caught": 1'

# A slow command is killed at the timeout and counts as caught.
exec mutate -timeout 500ms slow.json -- sh slow.sh
stdout '^hang +timeout +-1 '
cmp sum.txt sum.orig

# An interrupt kills the command and restores the files.
! exec mutate caught.json -- sh interrupt.sh
stderr 'interrupted; files restored'
cmp sum.txt sum.orig

# Setup errors exit 2 and run nothing.
! exec mutate ambiguous.json -- sh check.sh
stderr 'old text occurs 3 times in sum.txt, want 1'
! exec mutate missing.json -- sh check.sh
stderr 'old text occurs 0 times'
! exec mutate noop.json -- sh check.sh
stderr 'mutation chained: edits leave every file unchanged'
! exec mutate dup.json -- sh check.sh
stderr 'duplicate name'
cp bad.txt other.txt
! exec mutate caught.json -- sh check.sh
stderr 'baseline failed \(failed, exit 1\); mutations cannot be judged'
! stdout add_wrong
cp other.orig other.txt

# A file changed by someone else during the run is left alone.
! exec mutate caught.json -- sh meddle.sh
stderr 'sum.txt changed during the run; left as found, original not restored'
grep edited sum.txt
grep 'total = 4' sum.txt

-- sum.txt --
# total
a = 1
b = 2
total = 3
-- sum.orig --
# total
a = 1
b = 2
total = 3
-- bad.txt --
scale = 9
-- other.txt --
scale = 1
-- other.orig --
scale = 1
-- check.sh --
grep -q '^total = 3$' sum.txt || { echo "TestSum: total wrong"; exit 1; }
grep -q '^scale = 1$' other.txt || { echo "TestScale: scale wrong"; exit 1; }
-- interrupt.sh --
grep -q '^total = 3$' sum.txt && exit 0
kill -INT $PPID
sleep 30
-- meddle.sh --
grep -q '^total = 3$' sum.txt && exit 0
echo edited >> sum.txt
exit 1
-- slow.sh --
grep -q '^total = 3$' sum.txt || sleep 30
-- muts.json --
[
 {"name": "add_wrong", "file": "sum.txt", "old": "total = 3", "new": "total = 4", "want": "TestSum"},
 {"name": "comment", "file": "sum.txt", "old": "# total", "new": "# sum"},
 {"name": "two_files", "edits": [
   {"file": "sum.txt", "old": "a = 1", "new": "a = 2"},
   {"file": "other.txt", "old": "scale = 1", "new": "scale = 2"}]},
 {"name": "wrong_reason", "file": "other.txt", "old": "scale = 1", "new": "scale = 3", "want": "TestSum"}
]
-- caught.json --
[{"name": "add_wrong", "file": "sum.txt", "old": "total = 3", "new": "total = 4"}]
-- slow.json --
[{"name": "hang", "file": "sum.txt", "old": "total = 3", "new": "total = 9"}]
-- ambiguous.json --
[{"name": "amb", "file": "sum.txt", "old": " = ", "new": " := "}]
-- missing.json --
[{"name": "gone", "file": "sum.txt", "old": "nothing here", "new": "x"}]
-- noop.json --
[{"name": "chained", "edits": [
   {"file": "sum.txt", "old": "total = 3", "new": "total = 5"},
   {"file": "sum.txt", "old": "total = 5", "new": "total = 3"}]}]
-- dup.json --
[{"name": "a", "file": "sum.txt", "old": "a = 1", "new": "a = 2"},
 {"name": "a", "file": "sum.txt", "old": "b = 2", "new": "b = 3"}]
